messages:
alex: Quick idea for next week's triage — propose a buffered rotation + rolling agenda. Owners keep the same slot for 2 weeks (overlap helps handoffs), add a 10m buffer after the meeting for deep handoffs, and spin up an async pre-read thread for RFCs and design reviews. Thoughts?

tess: I like the 2-week overlap. Means fewer context switches. How do you see the buffer used? immediate follow-ups or just time to assign owners? :thinking:
omar: Buffer = do both. First 5m quick owner assignment and the rest for short handoffs or triage of anything that needs more than a ping. Calendar-wise we may need to shift start time by 5-10m to avoid clashes with other teams.
julia: Agree on async pre-read. If folks put 2 bullet TL;DR + 1 blocker in the thread before the meeting we can keep the call to ~25m. We should template it.
kevin: +1 on templating. Also suggest we run a 3-week A/B on keeping agenda rolling vs fixed buckets (bugs, infra, RFCs). Measure time spent per topic.
triage-bot: Suggestion: pin a template message in #eng-triage and auto-create a thread for each week's pre-read. Example template:```
Week: <date>
Owners: @owner1 @owner2
TL;DR: 2 bullets
Top bugs: - bug/123 brief
RFCs for preread: link(s)
Action items: short list
```
No auto-formatting for me but humans pls paste that in.

alex: Good call @triage-bot. Can we also add a short `status:` line for owners to post before the meeting like `status: on track / needs help / blocked`? Keeps us from asking obvious questions.

tess: I can run a short poll on preferred start time (keep current vs shift +10m). Will post later today. :white_check_mark:
omar: Also ask people if they're ok with 2-week owner windows. Some projects want weekly rotation. We should capture preferences per squad.
julia: I'll update the handbook page with the new template and link it in the poll. Handbook link: https://handbook.redwood/eng/triage (will update in poll post). :link:

kevin: For measuring A/B, suggest we track: avg meeting length, #items pushed to buffer, and %items resolved async. We can add a one-line metric post each meeting.
alex: Plan of record: tess runs poll for time + 2-week owner opt-in; julia updates handbook + posts template; triage-bot pins template and creates weekly preread thread; owners start adding `status:` before the meeting; we'll try rolling agenda + buffer for 3 weeks and capture the metrics kevin suggested. I'll follow up with a calendar invite tweak if poll prefers +10m shift.
tess: great — I'll post the poll ~2pm and tag all squad leads.
omar: :thumbsup: If anyone wants to volunteer for the first two-week slot (to pilot overlap) volunteer here.
julia: I'll take week 1 owner slot and pair with omar for overlap week 2.
kevin: I'll own the metrics collection for the A/B and share a tiny dashboard (sheet) after each meeting.
alex: Thanks everyone. If no major objections by EOD I'll update the meeting description and pin the preread template. :rocket:
